outcome.goal: Raise the request timeout floor in config.json and document the new retry back-off setting.
outcome.deliverable: The edited files in the working directory, plus a brief note of what changed.

facts.text: All files are in the current working directory; edit them in place.
The environment variable `$AB_TIMEOUT_MS` overrides `timeoutMs` at runtime; its name must not change.

criteria.text: config.json parses as JSON and contains timeoutMs 1000 and retryBackoffMs 250.

requirements.text: If `timeoutMs` in config.json is below 1000, set it to 1000; if it is already 1000 or more, leave it unchanged.
requirements.rationale: Requests under one second time out on the test network.

requirements.text: Add the key `retryBackoffMs` with the value 250 directly after `retries` in config.json, keeping the two-space indentation and the existing keys.
Add the line "- `retryBackoffMs`: delay between retries, in milliseconds (default 250)" to the list in docs/settings.md.

authorized.text: Reading, creating and editing files in the working directory.

files.docs/settings.md:
# Settings

- `timeoutMs`: request timeout in milliseconds (default 500)
- `retries`: retry count (default 1)
